subject: Sales → CS: OrbitGrid pilot handover & sequencing (owners + risks)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@orbitgrid.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@orbitgrid.com>, contracts@orbitgrid.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sales → CS: OrbitGrid pilot handover & sequencing (owners + risks)

Team — looping you all in for the official handoff on the OrbitGrid pilot (Deal OG-5421). Agreement is countersigned (DocuSign link below) and commercial highlights are: $150k pilot credit over 90 days, Hosted API with dedicated routing to eu-west-1 if needed, and a firm go-live target for the pilot evaluation on 2026-10-15.

Attachments: OrbitGrid_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf) — contains acceptance criteria and milestone payments; orbitgrid_runbook_template.xlsx (xlsx) — suggested CS sprint checklist.

Quick context: OrbitGrid is integrating Redwood for contextual assistant features in their enterprise planning UI. They want to run an internal pilot with ~10 power users, 3k tokens/session average, and privacy constraints: logs retained for 90 days; whole-request PII scrub before any long-term storage.

Immediate asks (sales → implementation/CS):
- Tech intake: environment access + sample payloads (Samir/Priya, can you share staging endpoints and a set of representative events by EOD 9/23?)
- Model profile: default to redwood-encoder-large; Karthik — confirm latency targets and whether quantized variant OK for pilot.
- Success criteria: 85% automated answer accuracy on our eval prompt set + <350ms 95th p50 for six concurrent users.
- Contract ops: contracts@orbitgrid.com — we've scheduled invoice milestone 1 on 10/01 per SOW.

Risks & open items:
1) Data residency: OrbitGrid flagged EU routing for some customers — we may need Dedicated routing if latency/SLOs deteriorate.
2) Auth: they use SAML SSO; we need a service account for server-to-server API calls.
3) Test data: they have a subset of redacted production they can share under an NDA addendum — need legal sign-off.

Owners proposed (preliminary):
- Implementation lead: karthik_iyer
- Customer Success (steward): monica_patel
- Executive sponsor / escalation: tessa_morgan

Links: HubSpot deal OG-5421, DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/NextStep/OrbitGrid-Agreement-OG-5421

Next step: Karthik/Monica — can you confirm owners and the first intake call availability 9/24 or 9/27? Samir/Priya — please send staging creds and a sample payload.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@orbitgrid.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@orbitgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: OrbitGrid pilot handover & sequencing (owners + risks)

Thanks Jasmine — noted. I can pick up Implementation as proposed. Quick tech asks (so we can scope sprint0):

1) Staging & API access
- Need a service account with API key + details on their proxy (if any). If they have an IP allowlist, please add our infra: 34.201.112.9 / 52.14.33.21 (we can provide full list in intake meeting).

2) Payload shape + max context
- Samir/Priya: please confirm sample payloads including typical context length. Our recommendation: cap initial session context to 6k tokens, and set a 4s token-emit timeout for streaming.

3) Data handling
- Confirm scrub rule (PII removal) and whether they want request/response logged to our observability or only a redacted event stream. If redacted-only, we’ll enable prefix caching off by default.

4) Model & performance
- I recommend starting with redwood-encoder-large with int8 quantized variant for lower cost; fallback to full fp16 if quality regressions show up. We’ll run a 2-day quant eval on their eval set once we receive samples.

5) Acceptance test harness
- I will own the initial eval harness. Ask: can OrbitGrid provide a labeled dev set of ~150 prompts by 9/29?

Proposed near-term milestones (implementation view):
- 9/24: Intake call (30–45m) — confirm owners and access
- 9/27: Staging access + first smoke test
- 10/01: Basic integration + run quant eval
- 10/08: Pilot go/no-go review

I’ll be on the intake call Wednesday 9/24 11am PT if that works for client; otherwise I can do 9/27. Monica — happy to sync on the 30/60/90 plan after the intake.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@orbitgrid.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@orbitgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: OrbitGrid pilot handover & sequencing (owners + risks)

Thanks all — I’ll own the CS steward role and will nominate the dedicated onboarding PM for OrbitGrid: Aparna Singh (cc’d on intake invite once confirmed). High level CS plan and immediate owner assignments below.

CS 30/60/90 (pilot-focused):
- Week 0–2 (Sprint0): environment validation, user mapping, acceptance prompts received, success metric dashboard baseline. Owners: Monica (steward), Karthik (implementation), OrbitGrid (Samir).
- Week 3–6: Feature integration, user training sessions (2 x 60m), and first acceptance run. Owners: Monica (training lead), internal SME (TBD).
- Week 7–12: Iterate on quality regressions, report generation, and pilot evaluation. Owners: Monica + product analytics.

Immediate checklist (Sprint0):
1) Intake call scheduled — propose 9/24 11:00am PT (Jasmine/Karthik please confirm).
2) Staging credentials + sample payloads — OrbitGrid deliverable by 9/23 EOD.
3) Labeled eval set (150 prompts) by 9/29.
4) Security questionnaire — Monica to send SOC2 scoping follow-up and data retention confirmation.
5) Access provisioning — fields we need: service account email, allowed IPs, SAML assertion format if available.

I’ve attached the runbook template (orbitgrid_runbook_template.xlsx) and will create a dedicated CS Confluence page for OrbitGrid after intake. For now, I’ve created a draft HubSpot playbook task list under deal OG-5421.

Open questions for OrbitGrid:
- Do you want Redwood to log full request/response to your workspace for debugging, or should we stay redacted until pilot acceptance?
- Will your power users be in multiple regions (this affects routing)?

Samir / Priya — can you confirm if 9/24 11am PT works and share the staging creds? If you prefer 9/27, we’ll shift milestones accordingly.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 212-555-0193
From: Samir Shah <samir@orbitgrid.com>

Subject: Re: Sales → CS: OrbitGrid pilot handover & sequencing (owners + risks)

Thanks Jasmine/Karthik/Monica — appreciate the clear plan. 9/24 11am PT works for us.

Action items from OrbitGrid:
- I’ll send staging API key and sample payloads by EOD 9/23 to samir_ops@orbitgrid.com and copy contracts@orbitgrid.com for traceability.
- We will provide a redacted labeled dev set of ~160 prompts by 9/29.
- On data logging: for debugging we can allow redwood to receive full request/responses into a sandbox telemetry stream for 2 weeks; after go/no-go we’ll switch to redacted-only unless explicitly needed.

Note: we may request EU routing for a subset of users mid-pilot; will flag that in the intake call.

Look forward to the intake call — I’ll accept the invite once Jasmine sends.

—Samir
